items.imageAlt: Black EVolution D-MAX XT4 4-passenger 4X4 all terrain golf cart, new, shown in profile view
items.title: 2026 EVolution D-MAX XT4 — Black
items.description: New black EVolution D-MAX XT4: a 4-passenger 4X4 all terrain golf cart with dual 12.6kW motors, 40-50 miles of range and a street-legal LSV package.
highlights: On-demand 4-wheel drive with dual 6.3kW AC motors
40-50 mile range on a 48V lithium pack
10.1" touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
24-speaker surround sound system
Built-in dash refrigerator and 74-qt portable cooler
LSV street-legal equipment package
